description: This file defines the JwtIssuerOptions class which encapsulates configuration options used for generating JWT tokens, including issuer, subject, audience, token lifespan, and signing credentials.

classes.name: JwtIssuerOptions
classes.description: A configuration class for JWT token issuance, containing properties such as issuer, subject, audience, token validity period, and signing credentials.

methods.name: JtiGenerator
methods.description: Generates a unique identifier (GUID) for each JWT token.

methods.name: Expiration
methods.description: Calculates the expiration DateTime based on the issued time and the ValidFor timespan.

methods.name: IssuedAt
methods.description: Returns the current UTC time when the token is issued.

methods.name: NotBefore
methods.description: Returns the current UTC time, indicating the token is valid immediately by default.
